li.label: Signal beneath the foundation
li.text: While digging the foundations of {COLONY}, the colonists broke into a sealed pre-war hatch. Its steel is etched with angular runes that no one can read, and from below comes a slow, steady pulse, like a heartbeat under the ground. A cracked holodisk lies wedged in the hatch seal.\n\nWhat do you do?

li.label: Force the hatch open
li.resultText: The hatch gives way with a groan. Beyond it lies a short corridor lined with dead terminals, and the pulse grows louder. Someone was here not long ago: fresh boot prints lead deeper and end at a collapsed wall. The holodisk is now safely in your hands.

li.label: Weld it shut and keep the holodisk
li.resultText: The welders work until dusk. The hatch is sealed, but the pulse does not stop, and at night it seems to come from right under the beds. The holodisk is quietly warm to the touch.

li.label: Dreams under the ash
li.text: All night the colonists dream the same dream: white laboratory walls, a stranger in a worn coat running through the snow with something glowing held to their chest, and a voice saying: "Keep the Spark away from all of them."\n\nIn the morning the holodisk hums on its own.

TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.label: a visitor in a beige coat
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterLabel: A visitor in a beige coat
TurboMegaMod.StoryQuestDef.letterText: A man in a rumpled beige trenchcoat stands at the edge of {COLONY}, staring at the ground as if listening to it. He calls himself {GIVER} and asks to speak with whoever is in charge.\n\n"The thing beneath you has woken. Everyone who can hear it is already on the way. I would rather you heard the truth from me first."

li.label: Open the hotel
li.text: After the dream the holodisk keeps humming, and one word returns again and again in the static: "guest". Someone is already on the way to {COLONY} and will not talk at the gate.\n\nOpen the hotel: place the reception desk and give it an area, put at least one guest bed inside that area, and allow guests on the Guests tab. The service readiness window of the reception desk shows what is still missing. The current goal is in the Chronicle.

li.arrivalText: A guest in a travelling coat walks up to {COLONY}, stops for a while and listens to the ground. The name in the guest book is {GIVER}.\n\n"I need a room. We will talk when I have settled in."
li.label: The truth about the Spark
li.text: {GIVER} speaks quietly. "Since the war, no soul has reached Heaven or Hell. Both are starving. Angels fall from the sky without grace, and demons tear at each other for scraps. Then a miracle happened in the Institute: a synthetic person was born with a real soul, a Spark. Someone carried the first one out of the labs and brought it here, to the Anchor beneath your home.\n\nEveryone will come for it. Heaven too. I am asking you not to give it to anyone, not even to my own kin."

li.label: Listen to the guest and promise to protect the Spark
li.resultText: "Thank you." {GIVER} touches the holodisk and it flickers: the first sector unlocks, showing a map of buried nodes like the one under your colony. "I will come back. Do not trust anyone who promises to keep the Spark safe."

li.label: Ask the angel to leave and stay out of your affairs
li.resultText: {GIVER} nods without offense. "Then at least look at this." One touch, and the first sector of the holodisk unlocks: a map of buried nodes like the one under your colony. The guest packs and leaves at once.
